think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed values in PostgreSQL. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob with a natural ordering. 3) If numeric, check for sentinel values (e.g., -1 or 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) rather than just “less/more”. 4) If the knob is boolean or enum (non-numeric), it does not fit the ‘special numerical knob’ definition; classify as not special under that definition.
